editorial.blurb: Katsu-Shack serves up authentic Japanese fried cutlets with crispy coatings and generous portions in a cozy, welcoming spot that feels like a quick escape to Tokyo.
editorial.insiderTip: Stop by on your way to Wrigley Field for a quick, energizing meal, or call ahead to see if they can accommodate group events—the owner Kazu is known for making celebrations special.
